responsibilities: Maintaining and developing our Looker environment and LookML solutions
Designing semantic models, governed datasets, and reusable analytics components
Supporting and developing Power BI solutions and related platform capabilities
Using Python to automate platform operations, integrations, monitoring, and governance
Troubleshooting platform issues and supporting upgrades and operational improvements
Improving the performance, usability, scalability, and reliability of our BI platforms
Managing access controls, metadata structures, and governance practices
Enabling self-service analytics across different business domains
Collaborating with the Platform Owner, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Architects, Analysts, and business stakeholders
Sharing best practices and helping users make effective use of our analytics platforms

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: you will help ensure that analysts and business teams have a reliable, well-structured, and governed foundation for reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, access control, metadata management and reliability run through the responsibilities, with no speed or shipping language anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Elisa is a Finnish, internationally operating telecommunications and technology company.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A listed telecoms operator, but the role serves internal reporting with no financial-reporting, audit or regulatory language.
evidence.collaboration_width: Platform Owner; Data Engineers; Analytics Engineers; Architects; Analysts
evidence.data_team_maturity: We are looking for a BI Engineer to strengthen our AI data platform team.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A dedicated platform team with a Platform Owner, Architects and separate Data and Analytics Engineers, running Looker and Power BI at organisation scale.
evidence.jd_authorship: Maintaining and developing our Looker environment and LookML solutions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets name LookML, the semantic layer, access controls and Python platform automation — the actual daily surface of the job.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: In this role, you will help ensure that analysts and business teams have a reliable, well-structured, and governed foundation for reporting
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role builds the shared BI platform that analysts and other data practitioners consume.
evidence.autonomy_level: Supporting and developing Power BI solutions and related platform capabilities
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The verbs are maintain, support, improve and troubleshoot against an existing platform owned by a Platform Owner.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The team is called the AI data platform team, but no AI skill is asked of the candidate anywhere in the responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Improving the performance, usability, scalability, and reliability of our BI platforms
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Platform reliability and troubleshooting are named concerns, but they sit alongside enablement work with no compliance or trust framing.

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Every verb — maintain, improve, troubleshoot, upgrade — operates on a platform that already exists.
evidence.language_gate: Good collaboration and communication skills in English
